description: The file defines a Flutter widget for a healthcare application's medical records screen. It manages fetching, filtering, displaying, and creating medical records, incorporating user role-based access control.

classes.name: MedicalRecordsScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the medical records screen, displaying and managing medical records based on user role.

classes.name: _MedicalRecordsScreenState
classes.description: State class for MedicalRecordsScreen, handling UI logic, state management, and interactions such as fetching data and creating records.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, determines user role, and fetches medical records accordingly.

methods.name: _loadWithFilter
methods.description: Fetches medical records based on the patient ID filter input.

methods.name: _createRecord
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create a new medical record, handles input validation, and invokes provider methods to create it.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the medical records screen, including filter controls, records list, and action button.
